summary: A small Pacific dragonet with swirling blue, orange and green markings. It forages on tiny bottom-dwelling prey and can be difficult to maintain unless an established aquarium provides a dependable live-food supply.
nativeRange: Western Pacific, from the Ryukyu Islands south to Australia.

features: Blue background with winding orange markings and a greenish-blue face.
Large pelvic fins support movement along the bottom.
Males have an elongated first dorsal spine.

habitat.description: Sheltered lagoons and inshore reefs, foraging close to the bottom.
habitat.diet: Tiny crustaceans and other invertebrates, including copepods and amphipods; some aquarium fish accept only live prey.
